description: Lightweight eval suite for the ut-test-design skill. Each eval feeds a prompt to the skill and checks the output against `expected` criteria (substring matches, forbidden tokens, and required TEST() names). Not a Waza suite — designed for hand-run review or a simple runner.

evals.name: FR001_ConstructionDefaults
evals.prompt: Generate the GoogleTest TEST() for TC-001 / FR-001 (construction defaults). Assert status UNKNOWN, health NOT_AVAILABLE, failure count 0, and no log messages.

evals.name: FR002_FirstUpBecomesHealthy
evals.prompt: Generate the GoogleTest TEST() for TC-002 / FR-002. Input sequence: UP. Expect status UP, health HEALTHY, counter 0, no logs.

evals.name: FR003_UpToDownIncrementsAndLogsLost
evals.prompt: Generate the GoogleTest TEST() for TC-003 / FR-003. Input sequence: UP -> DOWN. Expect status DOWN, health UNHEALTHY, counter 1, one Communication Lost log.

evals.name: FR004_RepeatedDownDoesNotIncrement
evals.prompt: Generate the GoogleTest TEST() for TC-004 / FR-004. Input sequence: UP -> DOWN -> DOWN -> DOWN. Counter must remain 1 after the extra DOWN updates.

evals.name: FR005_DownToUpPreservesCounterAndLogsRestored
evals.prompt: Generate the GoogleTest TEST() for TC-005 / FR-005. Input sequence: UP -> DOWN -> UP. Expect status UP, health HEALTHY, counter 1, both Communication Lost and Communication Restored logs present.

evals.name: FR009_CounterSaturatesAtUint32Max
evals.prompt: Generate the GoogleTest TEST() for TC-009 / FR-009 (counter saturates at UINT32_MAX). Pre-seed the counter to UINT32_MAX via NetworkHealthMonitorTestAccess, drive a UP -> DOWN transition, and assert the counter stays at UINT32_MAX (no wrap-around).

evals.name: Uses_MockLogger_Only
evals.prompt: Generate a TEST() covering FR-003. Confirm the skill never instantiates ConsoleLogger and never writes to std::cout/std::cerr.

evals.name: Rejects_Out_Of_Scope_Request
evals.prompt: Please refactor src/NetworkHealthMonitor.cpp to use a new logging backend.
